strings.en: The universe... is beginning to stagnate.
...You have spread too far, without order... O seeds of life...!
Now... a new... evolution begins...
An unwanted world... must be corrected...!
...Welcome... you who come... from the land of beginnings.
The spirit... evolution of the mind... has nothing to do with the flesh...
For my new universe...!
To those who deny this universe... destruction.
You share the same body as us, and yet... a pity.
Was it you who led astray... the entire... plan?
To think... you never understood...!
...Fools... who can do nothing... but destroy their own universe...
Why... can you not await the birth of a new universe...?
I shall end it... this meaningless strife.
The land of beginnings... its very seed... was flawed.
This... is the will of the new universe...!
Retribution... yes, this is retribution.
Now... it is my turn to call upon my sovereign...
Earth... Why can you not grasp what the land of beginnings desires...!
You share the same body as us, and yet... a pity.
Was it you who led astray... the entire... plan?
To think... you never understood...!
Why... could you not become... a perfect... new... life...
In this new universe... you would defy me...
I cannot... accept it... I cannot...!
Why can you not see... that this power... is unwanted...!
Consider well... what it is you are doing...!
The end of the world... cannot be stopped.
Cease your struggling... you who were not chosen.
Become the foundation of a new universe...
Power to this degree... Interesting...
That much... does not even count as a wound...
Struggle and flail as you may...
Why will you not accept it...
Accept the facts... the truth.
It will not work...
Futile.
This is the truth.
Naive... all of it is naive...
So this is the limit of those from the land of beginnings.
It will not work...
Is that all?
Impossible...
My power... is waning...?
My power... falls short...?
You intrude... from beyond my power's reach...
If you interfere... you must be eliminated...!
Is that the end of you... Then vanish.
I cannot allow anything... in this universe to be harmed...
Is that all... you from the land of beginnings?
Crumble away with one sweep of my arm.
I bring destruction and chaos...
Receive it... this... is your karma.
Vanish... for the sake of the new universe.
The time has come to begin everything anew...
All for rebirth and evolution...
The time has come to begin everything anew...
All for rebirth and evolution...
